explanation: Armenians call themselves Hay, and -stan, a Persian ending meaning land, gives Hayastan. The same ending turns up in Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan and Afghanistan.

claims.text: Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan and Azerbaijan are not called Hayastan in their own languages.
Armenians' own name for themselves is Hay.
The ending -stan comes from Persian and means land or place.
Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan and Afghanistan also end in -stan.
